finding: The published key at evidence/competition/frames/FRAME_CUSTODY_PUBLIC_KEY.pem (fingerprint c5e12498...) matches the smoke-test run's signing key, not the final 240-frame run's signing key (fingerprint becbb94d...). Two different keypairs were generated in two different local environments.
impact: A verifier that trusts only the single published PEM file cannot validate the final run's real signatures without also registering the second key.
reason: Deferred to keep the submission critical path (video URL, PR, final entry) moving under time pressure; this is a scoping/key-management gap, not evidence of tampering - both keys are locally generated and both runs are independently reconstructible from their PNG bytes regardless of signature trust.
